neighbours.label: being absorbed or preoccupied: '(so) focused / obsessed / caught up' on one thing at the expense of another
fire: Shoppers rush past the street musicians because they are so intent on their lists.
The engineers became so fixated on speed that they ignored battery life.
Teenagers can get so wrapped up in their phones that they forget to eat.
Voters were so preoccupied with gas prices that foreign policy barely registered.
The team was so absorbed in the redesign that nobody answered customer emails.
Too often new managers get so focused on targets that morale collapses.
Reviewers were so busy praising the effects that they missed the weak script.
Some parents are so consumed by their careers that they miss school plays.
quiet: Shoppers stop to listen to the street musicians before they check their lists.
The engineers measured speed first and then looked at battery life.
Teenagers usually check their phones after they finish eating dinner.
Voters were asked about gas prices and about foreign policy in the survey.
The team finished the redesign and then answered the customer emails.
New managers usually set targets in their first month and review morale later.
Reviewers praised the effects and also commented on the script.
Some parents leave work early so that they can attend school plays.
